description: This file defines the HolidayModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave API module. It is a data transfer object (DTO) that models holiday data for API responses, including properties like id, name, date, recurring, length, and lengthName. The class implements Normalizable and uses traits to facilitate serialization and normalization of Holiday entity objects.

classes.name: HolidayModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing holiday data in the OrangeHRM leave module API, encapsulating holiday properties for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HolidayModel with a Holiday entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
